caption: The drawing depicts a sleeveless waistcoat shown from the front, centered on a plain light beige background. The waistcoat is dark brown in color with a slightly lighter brown collar and lapels. It features a double-breasted design with two parallel columns of four buttons each, for a total of eight buttons visible on the front. Two horizontal welt pockets are positioned near the bottom on either side of the front. The armholes and inside of the waistcoat are depicted in a much lighter beige color, contrasting with the darker exterior. In the upper right corner, there is a line drawing of the back view of the waistcoat, showing the outline of the garment with two horizontal seams and two small bows or ties at the center. There is a faint handwritten inscription in the bottom left corner.
title: Waistcoat
